title: Python Project Structure: How to Choose the Right Layout
description: Learn how to structure Python projects: pick between flat and src/ layouts, organize your code, and apply the patterns to CLI, web, and GUI apps.
summary: Your Python project structure, also known as your project layout, is the arrangement of files and directories that determines how your code gets imported, tested, and packaged. Choosing between a flat and a src/ layout depends on the type of project you’re building and the trade-offs you accept.
